question: Which keyboard shortcut is used for adding bullets in MS Word 2010?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl + Shift + L**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ctrl + Shift + L** is the keyboard shortcut used to add bullets in MS Word 2010.
 
• This shortcut instantly converts the selected text into a bulleted list.
 
• Bulleted lists are used to organize items or points clearly and concisely.
 
• Using keyboard shortcuts like Ctrl + Shift + L can significantly enhance productivity and efficiency in document editing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bulleted Lists:**

 
 
• Bulleted lists are used to present information in an easy-to-read format.
 
• They help in breaking down complex information into manageable points.
 
• In MS Word, users can customize bullet styles using the "Bullets" option in the "Paragraph" group on the "Home" tab.
 
 
 
• **Keyboard Shortcuts:**
 
 
• Keyboard shortcuts are combinations of keys that perform specific commands quickly.
 
• They help in improving efficiency by reducing the need to navigate through menus.
 
• Common shortcuts in MS Word include Ctrl + C (copy), Ctrl + V (paste), and Ctrl + Z (undo).
 
 
 
• **MS Word 2010:**
 
 
• MS Word 2010 is a word processing application developed by Microsoft.
 
• It is part of the Microsoft Office 2010 suite.
 
• It offers various features such as text formatting, image insertion, and document collaboration.
 
 
 
• **Productivity Tips:**
 
 
• Learning and using keyboard shortcuts can save time and increase productivity.
 
• Organizing text with bullet points or numbered lists can make documents clearer and more professional.
 
• Regularly updating software ensures access to the latest features and security updates.
